title.en: Infectious Diseases (Measures to Prevent Spread of Infectious Diseases) (No. 2) Order 2007

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Infectious Diseases (Measures to Prevent Spread of Infectious Diseases) (No. 2) Order 2007 and shall come into operation on 1st March 2007.
2. For the purpose of preventing the spread of tuberculosis, the hospitals specified in the first column of the Schedule shall comply with the measures set out in the second column thereof.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Measures to Prevent Spread of Tuberculosis
First column
Second column
Hospital
Measure
1. National University Hospital
To provide the Director of the Tuberculosis Control Unit with access to the database of the Department of Laboratory Medicine, National University Hospital for the following purposes:
(a) to identify persons suspected to be suffering from tuberculosis or to be carriers of tuberculosis; and
(b) to track the results of confirmatory tuberculosis testing conducted on samples taken from persons referred to in sub-paragraph (a).
2. Singapore General Hospital
To provide the Director of the Tuberculosis Control Unit with access to the database of the Central Tuberculosis Laboratory, Singapore General Hospital for the following purposes:
(a) to identify persons suspected to be suffering from tuberculosis or to be carriers of tuberculosis; and
(b) to track the results of confirmatory tuberculosis testing conducted on samples taken from persons referred to in sub-paragraph (a).
